description.ja: 新たな映像作品『機動戦士Gundam GQuuuuuuX』（読み：ジークアクス）が始動！
description.en: A new video work “Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX” (pronounced: Sieg Ax) has started!

description.ja: 細部までを精密に再現した主人公機を最速立体化！
description.en: The fastest three-dimensional version of the main character's machine, which accurately reproduces every detail!

description.ja: • 特徴的な機体フォルムを忠実に再現。
description.en: • Faithfully reproduces the characteristic aircraft form.

description.ja: • 胴体、股関節など各部関節の可動によりダイナミックなアクションポーズが可能。
description.en: • Dynamic action poses are possible by movable joints such as the torso and hip joints.

description.ja: • バックパックはフレキシブルに可動し、様々な角度で表情がつけられる。
description.en: • The backpack is flexible and can be viewed from various angles.

description.ja: • バリエーション豊かな各種武装が付属。
description.en: • Comes with a wide variety of weapons.
